text: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
Love was diagnosed Tuesday with a right high-ankle sprain, which is expected to send him to injured reserve and keep him out for 4-to-5 weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tuesday that Huntley (toe) could be a candidate for injured reserve, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sunreports.
The Packers didn't activate Brooks (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.
San Francisco didn't activate Hobbs (groin) from injured reserve Saturday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.
Bullard (calf) wasn't activated from injured reserve Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

With George Pickens (hamstring) inactive, Flournoy is slated to move into the No. 2 WR role opposite CeeDee Lamb in Sunday's game against the Colts, while Jonathan Mingo will be the team's No. 3 receiver, Todd Archer of ESPN reports.
The Patriots activated Gilliam (knee), who remains questionable for Sunday's game against Detroit, from injured reserve Saturday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.
Randall (neck/hamstring) wasn't activated from injured reserve and will remain out for Monday's game against the Chargers, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.
With Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) inactive for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Mayer is in line to see an expanded role in Week 11.

Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce continues to rehab his left heel injury, and the wideout hasn't been ruled out for a return from injured reserve before the end of the season, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.
The Chiefs placed VanSumeren (knee) on the reserve/injured list Tuesday.

Head coach Dave Canales suggested Wednesday that a decision on Brooks (core) being activated from injured reserve before his 21-day window expires next week will hinge on the Panthers having a role available to him, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
The Broncos placed Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list Wednesday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
Doubs (shoulder), who remains on injured reserve, has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
